attchmntText: Centum Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Centum Electronics Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 5, 2026. The company reported Q2 revenue of INR312 crores, up 52% year-on-year, and H1 revenue of INR517 crores, up 32%. Q2 EBITDA grew 63% to INR40 crores, and PAT rose 77% to INR23 crores. The order book stood at approximately INR2,000 crores as of September 2026. The Board proposed increasing borrowing authorization from INR500 crores to INR1,000 crores, subject to shareholder approval. The company cited supply chain constraints affecting inventory and working capital. Management reaffirmed a medium-term growth target of 25% to 30%.

attchmntText: Centum Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Centum Electronics Limited has published a notice for a Postal Ballot in the Financial Express and Prajavani newspapers on 10th November 2026. The company is seeking shareholder approval for the matters contained in the Postal Ballot Notice. The resolution is pending vote and subject to shareholder approval. Results are awaited. Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited has issued e-tender notices for two projects. The first tender, CPC-98/2026-27, is for the supply of 24Fibre DWSM OPGW fibre optic cable and hardware set with an estimated cost of Rs. 3,08,10,214. The last date for bid submission is 30.11.26 at 11.00 AM. The second tender, CPC-99/2026-27, is for the design, engineering, supply, installation, and testing of a 400 kV DC LILO Line with an estimated cost of Rs. 23,51,77,998. The last date for bid submission is 09.12.2026 at 12:30 PM.

attchmntText: Centum Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Shareholders meeting
voiceSummary: Centum Electronics Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice seeking shareholder approval for two special resolutions. The first resolution proposes increasing the company's borrowing limits from Rs. 500 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore. The second resolution seeks consent to create charges on movable and immovable properties, both present and future, to secure borrowings up to Rs. 1,000 crore. The remote e-Voting period commences on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. IST and ends on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. IST. Mr. S.P. Nagarajan has been appointed as the Scrutinizer for the process. Voting is restricted to members registered as on Friday, November 6, 2026. Results will be announced within two working days of the e-Voting conclusion.
